events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 8, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album dropped 55 years ago (UK). Its message of peace and unity still resonates. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: British musician, singer, and songwriter Sting, born Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sting
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Sting! From The Police to his solo career, he's given us so many anthems. What's your top Sting or Police track?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Best Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! To celebrate 007, we're settling the debate: who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedic legend and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his genius is undeniable. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: Rubber Soul Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: 51 years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Widely seen as a pivotal album, how much did it change music for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the 46th anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon, who died on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on. What's the song that reminds you most of him?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the innovative and influential British musician, David Bowie. He was born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th Tribute
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Remembering David Bowie's incredible artistry and constant reinvention. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. He was born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: All shook up for Elvis! The King of Rock 'n' Roll would have been 92 today. What's your all-time favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today. He was born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the guitar wizard, Jimmy Page! What's the most iconic Led Zeppelin riff he ever created?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today. He was born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod Stewart
angles.copy: Rock legend Sir Rod Stewart is 82 today! Raise a glass to the man with the distinctive voice. What's your go-to Rod Stewart track?
